notes: Implemented all tests from Section 3.4 (Saliency Debug Overlay) of the Phase 4 priority plan. Created SaliencyDebugOverlay.js with pure coordinate functions (validateFocusPoint, focusPointToCanvasCoords, imageCenterToCanvasCoords, computeDebugMarkers), canvas rendering (render with DPR-aware markers, shift vectors, crop rectangles), and a factory (createDebugOverlay). Integrated into CollageAssembler render pipeline between selection highlight and blend-mode overlay. Added showDebugOverlay (default false) and focusPoints (default null) to CollageState. Documented export safety in ExportManager. All 128 tests pass covering: 15 coordinate transformation tests, 5 image center tests, 12 marker computation tests, 20 focus point validation tests, 6 constants tests, 17 basic canvas rendering tests, 5 marker positioning tests, 8 style verification tests, 15 edge case tests, 14 assembler integration tests, 6 state management tests, and 5 export safety tests. World-review found no critical issues; added integration notes to module JSDoc addressing stale data and Vue reactivity concerns for future ML saliency wiring.
